text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 16 yr old girl \u0026nbsp;who is a k\/c\/o DM type 1 was brought by her mother with c\/0 vomitings and pain abdomen since 4 days\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe was apparently alright 10 years back , one day she suddenly had fever with chills and burning sensation all over the body for which got diagnosed as DM-type 1 on routine investigations\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe is on regular medication since then on INSULIN(ISOPHANE-10u+REGULAR INSULIN 10u)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter 6yrs of regular medication she missed her doses on and off for which she got admitted in the hospital with c\/o vomitings ,SOB and burning micturition .necessary treatment was given and discharged\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2 years back ,Hospitalised for 1 week with similar complaints of vomitings, SOB . She got discharged with dietary counselling and insulin dosage advice\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;1 year back , she got admitted with c\/o fever, SOB (grade4)and acidotic breathing .ABG showed severe metabolic acidosis and ketones were positive. She was intubated and connected to mechanical ventilation . She was started on iv fluids and iv insulin algorithm 2 for management of DKA , extubated after 3 days .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENow,She had c\/o vomitings and pain abdomen since 4 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPain in epigastric region , dull aching type, non radiating,no aggrevating and relieving factors\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVomitings since 4 days ,3-4 episodes, non projectile, non bilious,contents being food particles\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShe had fever ,high grade,intermittent type associated with chills and rigors\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENoh\/o burning micturiton, sore throat,cough, confusion, loose stools, constipation,polyuria, polydipsia\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHABITS: mixed diet, normal appetite, adequate sleep,no addictions,bowel and bladder movements are regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFAMILY HISTORY: no similar complaints\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHer grand father is a k\/c\/o DM\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION: pt is c\/c\/c moderately built and nourished\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pallor, icterus, cyanosis, clubbing, koilonychia, pedal edema\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVITALS: Glomerulosclerosis \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Etiological diagnosis - \u0026nbsp;?? Nephrotic syndrome secondary to the diabetic nephropathy or CKD. \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; 2)Reasons for I) Azotemia : impaired renal excretion of urea and creatinine secondary to CKD.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;II) Anemia : decreased erythropoietin.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIII) Hypoalbunemia: capillary basement membrane and podocytes damage.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;IV) \u0026nbsp;acidosis: acidification of urine is lost. \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3) Rationale : syp potchlor was given because of the hypokalemia.. Inj. NaHCO3 was given because of metabolic acidosis ..Insulin and antihypertensives are given because known case of DM and HTN. Orofer XT was given because of anemia.. Inj. Lasix was given to decrease her volume overload. Spironolactone was given it was a potassium sparing diuretic.Calcium was given to the patient \u0026nbsp;because of hypocalcemia secondary to CKD. Indications of NaHCO3:metabolic acidosis in cardiac arrest, Tricyclic antidepressants, aspirin and phenobarbitone overdoses, Hyperkalemia, Crush injuries, C\/I \u0026nbsp;in certain conditions because of adverse reactions like Hypernatremia, metabolic alkalosis, cellulitis, seizures, Tetany, sodium retention, peripheral edema. \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;4) indication of dialysis in this pt: worsening of SOB secondary to metabolic acidosis with Anuria not resolved with high ceiling diuretics...Crucial factor: pt became symptomatic on 3rd day.... \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; 5) Causes of same condition : primary : Minimal change disease, Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, Membranous nephropathy. \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Secondary : DM, SLE, HIV , Viral hepatitis, malaria, amyloidosis, \u0026nbsp;Sarcoidosis, Drugs : Nsaids, gold, pencillamine Cancer: Hodgkin's and non Hodgkin's, solid tumours of GIT, RCC and lung.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E6)expected outcomes of ckd patients depend upon age,genes,associated co morbidities \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; This patients condition may deteriorate due to pleural effusion\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC5261605\/\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E7)association of ckd with hrpef\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EActivation of raas system\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHypercalcemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHyperphosphatemia\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EUremic toxins .these critically discuss the potentail contribution to coronary dysfunction, left ventricular stiffening \u0026nbsp;and delayed left ventricular relaxation\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E8)mean Hemoglobin levels,before and after study,in rhuepo group we’re 8.85+ or - 1.01g\/do and 9.90+ or - 0.29 g\/dl,respectively(p less than 0.001) and in control group were,9.00+ or -g\/dl and 7.81 + or - g\/dl,respectively\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC4293514\/\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E9)Anaemia contributes to the impairment of health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in patients with CKD [7]. Its impact on patients’ HRQoL burden is exacerbated by reduced physical capacity and energy levels among these patients.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E10)Malnutrition is an important complication in CRI patients and ESRD patients on dialysis.
